AAON_2017q3.text: Previous earnings: first-quarter sales were approximately flat, earnings declined, backlog reached $68.9 million, and higher warranty, promotional and stock-compensation expenses were disclosed.
AAON maintained its semiannual dividend and announced board changes. Independent coverage did not identify either event as a major stock catalyst.
No major independently covered customer win, acquisition, product launch, financing event or litigation development was identified.

AAON_2018q4.text: Previous earnings: AAON reported record backlog but lower earnings; labor availability, new-employee productivity, material inflation and warranty costs were already identified as operating constraints.
No major independently covered customer, product, financing, litigation or acquisition event was identified. The principal issue remained conversion of the existing backlog into profitable sales.

AAON_2019q2.text: Previous earnings/full-year report: AAON reported record 2018 sales and backlog, while weak margins were linked to labor, production and raw-material pressures.
No major independently covered company-specific transaction, customer announcement, product launch, litigation development or financing event was identified.

AAON_2019q4.text: Previous earnings: sales and net income increased, but the report did not fully resolve concern about AAON's ability to convert its large backlog into output.
Broad-market trade worries contributed to market volatility; this was a market-wide development rather than an AAON-specific operating event.
No major independently covered company-specific deal, customer announcement, litigation development or financing event was identified.

AAON_2020q1.text: Previous earnings: AAON said sheet-metal production constrained sales, while new fabrication equipment was beginning to improve capacity; a new research laboratory opened.
No major independently covered company-specific acquisition, customer win, product launch, litigation event or financing change was identified.

AAON_2020q2.text: Previous earnings/full-year report: AAON reported sharply higher fourth-quarter and full-year earnings, indicating improved production execution.
AAON approved a new share-repurchase program during the early COVID-19 market selloff.
COVID-19 uncertainty dominated the external environment; no other major independently covered AAON-specific transaction or litigation event was identified.

AAON_2021q4.text: Previous earnings: AAON reported record second-quarter sales and a substantial increase in backlog, while supply constraints and inflation were emerging as key margin risks.

No major independently covered company-specific acquisition, customer announcement, product launch, financing event or litigation development was identified. Inflation and supply-chain pressure remained the main operating context.

AAON_2022q3.text: Previous earnings: AAON reported record first-quarter sales and backlog of $461.4 million, while inflation and constrained production continued to pressure profitability.
AAON maintained its dividend and announced leadership changes following the founder's transition away from the executive-chairman role.
No other major independently covered customer, product, litigation or financing event was identified; BASX integration and cost recovery remained central.

AAON_2023q1.text: Previous earnings: AAON reported record third-quarter sales, earnings and backlog; pricing, production growth and BASX contributed to the improvement.

No major independently covered customer win, acquisition, product launch, litigation development or financing event was identified. Expectations centered on continued margin recovery and backlog conversion.

AAON_2024q1.text: Previous earnings: AAON reported strong third-quarter sales and earnings growth, with pricing, productivity and backlog supporting the outlook.

No major independently covered company-specific customer deal, product launch, acquisition, litigation or financing event was identified. The stock's relative strength mainly reflected continued earnings and margin momentum.

AAON_2024q4.text: Previous earnings: AAON reported record second-quarter sales and earnings after resolving most first-quarter production issues; BASX performance rebounded sharply.
AAON launched Delta Class, a new dedicated outdoor-air-system product platform.
AAON announced approximately $174.5 million of liquid-cooling orders from one data-center customer, with most production and delivery expected in the first half of 2025.
Independent industry coverage highlighted the data-center order and AAON's ongoing capacity investment to meet liquid-cooling demand.
